title: Fixed-module constructible sheaves have etale origin
statement: For any finite commutative ring $\Lambda$ and scheme X, a fixed-module-valued pro-etale sheaf F is constructible in the source-library sense (a finite global scheme stratification whose restrictions admit finite constant models) if and only if F is isomorphic to $\nu$_X^*G for a constructible fixed-module-valued etale sheaf G. This is the exact existing declaration in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.ProEtale.ConstructibleSheaf, distinct from the separately attached ringed-coefficient equivalence on the parent node. The notions are [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf] and [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism].

source.place: Tags 099Y and 09AK; fixed-module coefficients and finite global stratifications

proof.text: Choose the given stratification and use [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-stratified-counit]. Set G=ν_*F and take the counit isomorphism ν^*G≅F.

Retain that same stratification. Comparison pullback compatibility [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback] identifies comparison of every stratum restriction of G with the corresponding restriction of F. Transport its finite models through this isomorphism and apply [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-finite-local-constancy-reflection]. The same partition witnesses constructibility of G.

The reverse direction uses the existing proved isConstructible_comparisonUpperStar_obj and invariance under isomorphism: comparison preserves the finite constant models on the same finite stratification.

theorem isConstructible_iff_exists_isConstructibleSheaf_iso_comparisonUpperStar_obj [Finite Λ]
    {T : Scheme.{u}} {F : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)} :
    IsConstructible Λ F ↔
      ∃ G : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ), Scheme.IsConstructibleSheaf G ∧
        Nonempty ((ν^*(T)[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj G ≅ F)
